# Petcovered

> Affordable pet health insurance for South African pet owners.

## About

Petcovered helps people in South Africa protect their dogs and cats with straightforward pet health insurance. Plans are designed around affordability, illness cover, fast payouts, and access to a licensed vet of the customer's choice.

## Important facts

- Website: https://petcovered.co.za/
- Country served: South Africa
- Contact: hello@petcovered.co.za
- Underwriter: GENRIC Insurance (FSP 43638)
- Primary topics: pet insurance, dog insurance, cat insurance, pet healthcare, claims, plans

## Key pages

- Home: https://petcovered.co.za/
- Plans: https://petcovered.co.za/plans
- About Petcovered: https://petcovered.co.za/about

Use the website's plan and policy wording pages as the source of truth for eligibility, exclusions, waiting periods, limits, premiums, and claims requirements.
